basic_info.description: Exceptional Opportunity to Own a signature Marina Triplex - Just 1.5 Blocks from Marina Green!  Built in 1937, this 4100 sq ft Spanish Revival Triplex offers a blend of timeless charm and modern investment potential in one of SF's most coveted neighborhoods. With one unit vacant and the other two renting near market rates, this property presents an incredible opportunity for both investors and owner-occupier. The building's classic architectural details include gorgeous crown molding ,elegant arched windows and period craftsmanship throughout. The top and middle floors each feature spacious 2-bed/2bath layouts with a sunroom. The vacant 1-bd/1ba unit overlooks a beautifully manicured garden. Two car parking reserved for the owner. In-unit laundries for each. Situated just steps from the Marina Green, the waterfront and Chestnut Street, this is a rare chance to own a piece of SF history with excellent rental income potential.
